projects.name: Dreshaj Elite Cars
projects.description:
**Brief:** The client wanted a professional website for Korean import cars with live inventory.

**What I built:** A car listing platform that automatically syncs vehicles, photos, prices, and details from Encar.com.

**Result:** The dealership can show fresh inventory online without updating every listing by hand.

projects.name: MonitorimiDuhanit
projects.description:
**Problem:** Tobacco and vape promotions online were hard to track consistently across Kosovo.

**What I built:** A monitoring platform that gathers online content, uses AI to flag relevant posts, and shows trends in a dashboard.

**Result:** Researchers can review patterns, export findings, and spend less time checking sources manually.

projects.name: AAB Bus
projects.description:
**Problem:** Students and staff needed a clearer way to follow university buses in real time.

**What I built:** A mobile app that connects to AAB's existing systems for live bus locations, routes, schedules, and profiles.

**Result:** Users can check bus movement and departure details directly from their phone without the app storing their data.

projects.name: Go+
projects.description:
**Problem:** The Go+ brand needed a product page that felt more polished and memorable.

**What I built:** An animated landing page with scroll effects and interactive product visuals.

**Result:** The brand gets a sharper first impression and a page that feels more premium.

projects.name: FACEITData
projects.description:
**Problem:** CS2 players wanted a faster way to check FACEIT stats and recent match performance.

**What I built:** A cross-platform app with player search, match history, favorites, and shareable stat cards.

**Result:** Players can review and share performance from one focused app on web or mobile.

projects.name: Kujom
projects.description:
**Brief:** I wanted to make a fun Kosovo-only geography guessing game while Street View still feels new.

**What I built:** A game with 10,000 real locations, solo play, shared challenges, live rooms, and scoreboards.

**Result:** Players can explore Kosovo, compete on the same rounds, and compare scores with friends.

projects.name: Kommits
projects.description:
**Problem:** Writing clear commit messages can slow developers down during everyday work.

**What I built:** A small tool that turns rough change notes into cleaner commit messages.

**Result:** Developers get a useful message faster and keep their history easier to read.

projects.name: KodoBashke
projects.description:
**Problem:** Students with project ideas often struggle to find the right people to build with.

**What I built:** A mobile app for profiles, project posts, and chat between potential collaborators.

**Result:** People can discover projects, connect with others, and start building together.

projects.name: VikiBarber
projects.description:
**Problem:** A local barbershop needed a simpler way to take appointments online.

**What I built:** A booking website with an admin dashboard for appointments and availability.

**Result:** Customers can book anytime, and the shop can manage its schedule from one place.
